intro.h2: Welcome to the Canadian High School of Dakar
intro.accroche: African roots. Global opportunities. Confidence in the future.
intro.p1: The Canadian High School of Dakar is an international school located in the Point E neighbourhood, a member of the BEM Africa network. We welcome students from Grade 6 through Grade 12 and promote the Ontario Canadian curriculum, a system ranked among the five most effective in the world according to OECD PISA assessments.
intro.p2: Our ambition can be stated simply: to develop critical thinkers and future leaders who are proud of their culture and ready for the world.
intro.stat1_label: BEM Africa Group founded in Dakar
intro.stat2_label: Students and auditors trained in the network
intro.stat3_label: Nationalities within the BEM Africa Group
intro.stat4_label: Partner universities and schools in the network

programmes.intro: Every child is different. That is why LCD offers three pathways, from Grade 6 through Grade 12 and beyond.
programmes.p1_text: Your child follows a fully Canadian curriculum. Each course is validated at their own pace, with no national exam. This is the most direct path to an international university.
programmes.p1_cle: Ontario Secondary School Diploma — the Canadian high school credential
programmes.p2_text: The best of both worlds. Your child follows the Senegalese curriculum, enriched with Canadian modules. They keep their familiar reference points while gradually opening up to international standards.
programmes.p2_cle: Senegalese Baccalaureate + official attestation of completed Canadian modules
programmes.p3_text: Your child has their Bac, but their academic profile does not reflect their true potential. This pathway strengthens key subjects and opens the door to more selective universities.
programmes.p3_cle: A stronger profile and a wider range of options
programmes.passerelle: A bridge exists between the Hybrid Programme and the Canadian Programme starting from Grade 9. You are not locking in your child's future from the moment of enrolment.

diff.h2: What distinguishes the Canadian High School of Dakar
diff.d1_text: Ontario's education system, ranked among the five best in the world by the OECD.
diff.d2_text: French and English, every day, from Grade 6 onward, with no language prerequisite.
diff.d3_text: Deliberately small class sizes. A team that knows every child by name.
diff.d4_text: In Point E, at the heart of Dakar, in one of the capital's best-connected neighbourhoods.
diff.d5_text: Debate, robotics, coding, sport, arts. School does not stop at the classroom door.
diff.d6_text: University guidance integrated from Grade 10 onward, with support for the full application process.

protection.intro: A child learns best when they feel safe. That is why the Canadian High School of Dakar applies a strict child protection policy.
protection.e1: A trained, identified, and reachable child protection officer within the school.
protection.e2: Mandatory child protection training for all staff, without exception.
protection.e3: A clear anti-bullying policy communicated to all students and families.
protection.e4: Reliable and confidential reporting channels, accessible to both students and parents.
protection.e5: Systematic background checks for every new hire.

familles.h2: Your direct link to school life
familles.text: A school cannot succeed alone. Regular communication, progress updates, and an available team mean you always know where your child stands — without having to chase the information.

dilemme.intro: Every ambitious parent runs into the same wall. Until now, there were only two paths forward — and both came at a cost.
dilemme.c1_texte: At fifteen or sixteen, to a boarding school or host family overseas. The financial cost is heavy. The emotional risk is real. And you lose your child at precisely the age when they need you most.
dilemme.c2_texte: In a solid, rigorous, respected system. But one whose diploma requires an equivalency process and does not, on its own, open the doors of leading universities in North America or Europe.
dilemme.transition: Most families make the call in pain. Others keep putting it off, year after year, until it is too late to do it well.
dilemme.encadre_titre: Your child can now earn a Canadian diploma without leaving Senegal.
dilemme.encadre_texte: The Canadian High School of Dakar exists because this choice should never have to be made. We have established a secondary programme at Ontario standards in Point E — from middle school through Grade 12 — that takes your child all the way to international university admission while letting them grow up beside their family, in their language, in their city.

closing.text: Spots for the first cohort are limited. Applications are processed in order of receipt — early applicants have priority for campus visits and level placement.
